g.text: Cell protection. BAT_N is the cell negative, NOT system GND: the FS8205A sits between them.

g.desc: Cell protection. BAT_N is the cell negative, NOT system GND: the FS8205A sits between them.

g.text: DW01A trips: overcharge 4.30 V, overdischarge 2.40 V (release 3.0 V), overcurrent 150 mV across both FETs (about 2.5 A).

g.desc: DW01A trips: overcharge 4.30 V, overdischarge 2.40 V (release 3.0 V), overcurrent 150 mV across both FETs (about 2.5 A).

g.text: The 18650 sits in the enclosure cradle and plugs into J5 (pin 1 = positive). Q2 blocks a reversed lead.

g.desc: The 18650 sits in the enclosure cradle and plugs into J5 (pin 1 = positive). Q2 blocks a reversed lead.

g.text: After connecting a cell, plug USB in once to wake the DW01A.

g.desc: After connecting a cell, plug USB in once to wake the DW01A.

g.text: USB-C 5 V -> BQ24074 (charger + power path, VSYS = 4.4 V on USB, VBAT on battery) -> TPS62740 (3.3 V, all four VSEL high)

g.desc: USB-C 5 V -> BQ24074 (charger + power path, VSYS = 4.4 V on USB, VBAT on battery) -> TPS62740 (3.3 V, all four VSEL high)

g.text: USB500 mode: EN2 = GND, EN1 high only while VBUS is present (no battery drain through the EN pull-down).

g.desc: USB500 mode: EN2 = GND, EN1 high only while VBUS is present (no battery drain through the EN pull-down).

g.text: Charge 494 mA (ISET 1.8k), safety timer 9.1 h (TMR 68k), termination 10 % (ITERM open).

g.desc: Charge 494 mA (ISET 1.8k), safety timer 9.1 h (TMR 68k), termination 10 % (ITERM open).

g.text: TH1 sits beside J5: it senses board temperature next to the cell, not the cell itself. Without a thermistor fit a fixed 10k.

g.desc: TH1 sits beside J5: it senses board temperature next to the cell, not the cell itself. Without a thermistor fit a fixed 10k.
